title: LFM2.5: 24B Brain, 2B at Work — a Local Agent Model
status: Owner approved runners-up batch on 2026-10-15 for artifact-only videos. No public Release, no Buffer scheduling or posting. Approved Option-3 Chatterbox flow voice; no on-screen credit captions.

facts.vendor_speed: up to 184 tok/s on Apple M5 Max (Liquid AI)

credits_on_screen: Own spec and formats cards created for this video. Source links in post/description only. No on-screen credits.
verify_before_render: HF card checked 2026-10-15: 24.0B total, about 2.45B active per token, 64 experts top-4, 131K context, 36T training tokens. Say 'about two billion' active.
Speed is the vendor's figure, not ours: up to 184 tok/s on an Apple M5 Max, attributed to Liquid AI in speech and on screen. We did not run the 24B model; no local benchmark is claimed.
License: weights under Liquid's LFM 1.0 licence (HF license_name lfm1.0). Never call it Apache, MIT, or unrestricted open source.
Mandatory catches: it is a pure reasoning model that always thinks before answering, and Liquid AI recommends pairing it with retrieval or search for knowledge work.
Formats exist as separate HF repos: GGUF for llama.cpp, MLX-4bit for Apple Silicon, ONNX, FP8. Install scene shows the GGUF route generically; no fake terminal output of a real run.
Visuals are our own cards in captures/model-lfm25-01; no third-party clips or copied benchmark charts. No on-screen credit captions.

scenes.heading: 24B BRAIN. *2B AT WORK.*
scenes.say: Twenty-four billion parameters, but only about two billion do the work on each token.

scenes.heading: MEET *LFM2.5*
scenes.say: This is {LFM2.5|L F M two point five}, Liquid AI's new model built for agents that run on your own device.

scenes.heading: REASONING AT *MOE SPEED*
scenes.label: Liquid AI's test · Apple M5 Max
scenes.say: Liquid AI reports up to one hundred eighty-four tokens per second on Apple's {M5 Max|M five Max} chip.

scenes.heading: BUILT TO *ACT*
scenes.say: It thinks before it answers, calls tools in your apps, and is built to run privately on your device.

scenes.heading: RUN IT *LOCALLY*
lines: # or the MLX build on a Mac
scenes.say: Download the weights as {GGUF|G G U F} for local runs, or use the {MLX|M L X} build on a Mac.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *DOWNLOAD*
scenes.say: The catches: it always thinks before answering, so simple replies take longer; Liquid AI says pair it with search for knowledge work; and the weights use their {LFM 1.0|L F M one point zero} licence, not Apache. But you get twenty-four billion parameter smarts at two billion speed.
Want a local agent model? Comment LFM and I will pin the model card.

youtube.description:
Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B carries 24B parameters but activates only about 2B per token, aiming at fast private agents on-device. Liquid AI reports up to 184 tok/s on an Apple M5 Max (vendor figure; we did not run the 24B model). It always thinks before answering, and Liquid AI recommends pairing it with retrieval or search for knowledge work. Weights are under the LFM 1.0 licence, with GGUF, MLX, ONNX and FP8 builds.
Source: https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B
